name: System Tray (Toggleable Auto-hide)
author: felipecpaiva
description: Drop-in replacement for Omarchy's stock tray widget. Fixes the chevron reserving bar space even when there is nothing to hide, and adds an 'alwaysShow' setting so you can turn icon auto-hiding off entirely from the Super+Space menu.

barWidget.description: Status notifier items, with optional auto-hide
